senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="O01315">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 23:2">Targ. Gen. XXIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 116b:4">Yeb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>סִפְדִי בעליך</he> observe mourning for thy husband.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 28b">M. Kat. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>דִּיסְ׳ וִסְפְּדוּנֵוה</he> for him who has mourned for others, others will mourn; <cite ref="Ketubot 72a">Keth. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>דִּסְ׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:6">Tosef. ib. VII, 6</cite> <he>סְפוֹד דיִסְפְּדוּנָךְ</he> mourn, in order that people may mourn for thee; Y. ib. VII, 31ᵇ bot. (corr. acc.). Meg. Taan. ch. I; <cite ref="Shabbat 21b">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דלא למִסְפֵּד</he> when no lamentations may be held; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:18">Targ. Lam. I, 18</cite>.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:6">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא יומא לא אתו לאַסְפּוּדֵיה</he> that day (when he died), they did not come to mourn for him.
<cite ref="Megillah 28b:10">Meg. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אַכְפְּדָהּ לכלתיה וכ׳</he> held funeral services for his daughter-in-law in the synagogue; a. fr.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:7">Koh. R. to XII, 7</cite> <he>הוה מַסְפִּיד בחדא ידא וכ׳</he> made the motion of mourning with one hand and of praising (Nebuchadnezzar) with the other; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 364:1-3">Yalk. Ez. 364</cite> <he>הוון … ומַסְפִּידִין וכ׳</he>.
